name: kipas
description: Kipas: a modern, friendly offline password manager (Electron + React), in the spirit of KeePass

scripts.setup: npm --prefix ui install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.build: npm --prefix ui run build && npm --prefix desktop run build
scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/run.mjs desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix ui run typecheck && npm --prefix desktop run typecheck
